title: Course Scheduled Quiz Access
description: Implement date-based unlocks for course quizzes and questions end to end. Locked items must remain visible as previews behind a tint, cannot open through pointer/keyboard UI or ordinary deep links, and may be opened only by a hidden URL argument. Current architecture course unlocks Energy only; all other quizzes remain locked. Add schema-first language-neutral cases, independent library validation and end-to-end tests. Preserve concurrent work; no modifying Git commands or worktrees.
summary: Implemented schema-first scheduled topic, quiz and question access with TypeScript/Rust mirrors, inert tinted previews, localized status, exact-date timers, sleeping-tab rechecks, session/navigation/saved-run guards and hidden ?preview=1 author access. Energy is unlocked and all other course topics remain locked, including their new concurrent quiz content. Core: 563 passing tests; focused UI/course regressions: 339 passing tests; final access UI: 9 passing tests. Current-source TypeScript check and real browser scenarios at desktop/phone widths, deep links, author preview and automatic topic/question releases passed against the expanded 10-quiz course. Standard source admission still prevents Rust/proctor full-stack verification with missing .cache/b/l/fixed.dir; workspace publication drift is documented with reproducible diagnostic configurations in verification.md. Concurrent edits preserved; no Git modifications or worktrees. See summary.md and verification.md for results and limits.
